name: UnrestrictMirroring
tagline: 在 iOS 18.0+ 解锁设备时继续使用 iPhone Mirroring，并启用 Device Hub 远程控制。
description: UnrestrictMirroring 允许设备保持解锁时继续使用 iPhone Mirroring 与相机，从而在手机和镜像画面中同时运行不同 App。
它还可在 iOS 18.0+ 启用新版 Device Hub 远程控制功能。此包由上游作者 khanhduytran0 开发，Banana 源仅提供安装镜像。
notice: ⚠️ 实验性预发布。连接镜像时设备仍会锁定，并存在双端键盘焦点冲突、锁屏后镜像异常及 Spotlight 互斥等已知限制。
features: 设备解锁时继续使用 iPhone Mirroring
镜像期间继续使用设备相机
在手机和镜像画面中同时运行不同 App
在 iOS 18.0+ 启用 Device Hub 远程控制
usage: 安装与你越狱环境对应的软件包并 Respring。
按照系统原有方式连接 iPhone Mirroring 或 Device Hub。
若锁屏后镜像无法继续启动 App，请先解锁设备再重新连接。
避免同时在设备与镜像画面中争夺键盘焦点。

changes: 修复可能影响无关 App 或系统进程的问题，并增强使用稳定性。

en.name: UnrestrictMirroring
en.tagline: Keep using iPhone Mirroring while unlocked and enable Device Hub remote control on iOS 18.0+.
description: UnrestrictMirroring allows iPhone Mirroring and the camera to remain usable while the device is unlocked, letting different apps run on the device and mirrored display at the same time.
It also enables newer Device Hub remote control on iOS 18.0+. The package is developed upstream by khanhduytran0; the Banana repository only provides an installation mirror.
en.notice: ⚠️ Experimental pre-release. The device still locks when mirroring connects, with known limitations including keyboard-focus conflicts, broken mirroring after locking, and Spotlight being available on only one screen at a time.
features: Keep using iPhone Mirroring while the device is unlocked
Continue using the device camera during mirroring
Run different apps on the device and mirrored display simultaneously
Enable Device Hub remote control on iOS 18.0+
usage: Install the package matching your jailbreak environment and Respring.
Connect through iPhone Mirroring or Device Hub normally.
If mirroring stops launching apps after the device locks, unlock it and reconnect.
Avoid competing for keyboard focus on the device and mirrored screen at the same time.

changes: Fixed an issue that could affect unrelated apps or system processes and improved stability.
